name: 4-fluoro-DMT
summary: 4-Fluoro-DMT (or 4-F-DMT), also known as 4-fluoro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor agonist of the tryptamine family and a close analogue of psilocin (4-HO-DMT) and dimethyltryptamine (DMT). It is a modestly selective serotonin 5-HT2C receptor full agonist and doesn't appear to produce psychedelic-like effects in animals but instead produces antiobsessional-like effects.

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluoro-DMT's affinity (Ki) for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor was 135 nM. This can be compared to psilocin's affinity of 378 nM and serotonin's affinity of 1.7 nM. In another study, 4-F-DMT showed affinities (Ki) of 335 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 8.39 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 82–84 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist; Psychoactive drug; Entactogen

uses.text: It has been encountered online as a novel designer drug, with claimed mild entactogen-like effects.

fact.en: It is psilocin with the hydroxy group swapped for a fluorine atom. That small change seems to remove psychedelic-like effects in animals, which instead show signs resembling an anti-obsessional drug.
fact.zh: 它相當於把脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）上的羥基換成氟原子。這個小小的改變似乎讓它在動物身上失去了類似迷幻藥的作用，反而出現類似抗強迫症藥物的表現。
fact.zhHans: 它相当于把脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）上的羟基换成氟原子。这个小小的改变似乎让它在动物身上失去了类似迷幻药的作用，反而出现类似抗强迫症药物的表现。
